title: Qamus two-vote artifact bundle v1 / v1.1
description: Reconstructible evidence contract behind any two_vote / bulk_two_vote_certified claim: two independent vote records plus agreement computed on conclusion AND grammatical reason, never on gloss text. Historical claims without artifacts are representable only as two_vote_claimed_unverified and are never fabricated. v1.1 replaces free-prose comparison with governed vocabulary: case_or_mood.value/sign are closed enums; conclusion.function, conclusion.attachment_key and reason_key must be ids from qamus/skills/reason-key-registry.jsonl; case_or_mood.mood_basis (governed|tajarrud|default) gates the governor requirement (raf' by tajarrud is valid with governor null; tajarrud/default only license raf3); governed_expression means 'the expression THIS token governs (null if none)' with governed_by_scope for what governs this token; segment surfaces are recorded as displayed in the mushaf token including shadda from assimilation (e.g. لِّ) with normalized_segment / governor.normalized_surface carrying the dictionary-normalized form (normalized wins in comparison); lexical_target declares whether the vote's lexical identity addresses the clitic entry or the whole fused token, and root_label_suppressed marks public root-label suppression (root must then be null). Prose stays in contextual_function/attachment/referent/grammatical_reason, uncompared.

segment_surface.description: Recorded as displayed inside the mushaf token, including shadda arising from assimilation (e.g. لِّ).

normalized_segment.description: v1.1: dictionary-normalized form of the segment (e.g. لِ for displayed لِّ).

lexical_target.description: v1.1 (required there): what the vote's lexical_identity/root addresses on a fused token — the clitic's own dictionary entry, or the whole orthographic token.

root_label_suppressed.description: v1.1 policy flag: true when the public root label is deliberately suppressed; root must then be null, so null-vs-attested root is a policy difference, not a comparison miss.

reason_key.description: v1: free lowercase-hyphen token. v1.1: must be an id of kind reason_key in qamus/skills/reason-key-registry.jsonl; votes cite the id here and elaborate freely in grammatical_reason.

contextual_function.description: Prose. Compared in v1; uncompared elaboration in v1.1 (function carries the compared value).

function.description: v1.1 (required there): governed function key — an id of kind function in qamus/skills/reason-key-registry.jsonl. Compared instead of contextual_function prose.

surface.description: As displayed, including shadda from assimilation for token-internal governors (e.g. لِّ).

normalized_surface.description: v1.1: dictionary-normalized surface (e.g. لِ); wins over surface in v1.1 comparison.

relation.description: Prose. Compared in v1; uncompared elaboration in v1.1.

governor.description: The operator governing THIS token. v1.1: required only when case_or_mood.mood_basis=governed; null is valid for raf' by tajarrud/default.

governed_expression.description: v1.1 semantics (fixed): the expression THIS token governs — null if it governs nothing. What governs this token belongs in governed_by_scope / governor.

governed_by_scope.description: v1.1 (optional): what governs this token, as prose scope info. Uncompared.

value.description: v1: free prose. v1.1: enum raf3|nasb|jarr|jazm|none.

mood_basis.description: v1.1 (required for inflected values, null when value=none): governed = an operator assigns the case/mood (governor required); tajarrud = raf' by absence of nasib/jazim; default = mood by default. tajarrud/default only license raf3.

attachment.description: Prose. Compared in v1; uncompared elaboration in v1.1 (attachment_key carries the compared value).

attachment_key.description: v1.1: governed attachment key — an id of kind attachment in qamus/skills/reason-key-registry.jsonl (null if no attachment claim).

referent.description: Prose. Compared in v1; uncompared elaboration in v1.1.
